pack.title: Comments dms
pack.description: Set a boundary around personal comments.

scenarios.setting: Someone sends unsolicited criticism of your appearance in a direct message.
scenarios.jab: You'd look better if you lost a little weight.
scenarios.goal: Set a boundary around personal comments.

replies.line: I don't want comments about my body.
replies.why: It states the boundary without accepting an invitation to evaluate your appearance.
replies.delivery: Keep the message short; you can mute or block repeated unwanted contact rather than continue explaining.

replies.why: It makes the unwanted behavior explicit and asks it to stop.
replies.delivery: Keep the message short; you can mute or block repeated unwanted contact rather than continue explaining.

replies.line: Please keep comments about my body out of our conversation.
replies.why: It requests a respectful limit without debating the proposed advice.
replies.delivery: Keep the message short; you can mute or block repeated unwanted contact rather than continue explaining.

replies.line: My body isn't accepting unsolicited reviews.
replies.why: A restrained metaphor declines evaluation without attacking the sender.
replies.delivery: Keep the message short; you can mute or block repeated unwanted contact rather than continue explaining.

followUp.jab: I was just trying to help.
followUp.line: I didn't ask for that help; please don't repeat the comment.
followUp.why: It separates claimed intention from the boundary you are setting.
followUp.delivery: Keep the message short; you can mute or block repeated unwanted contact rather than continue explaining.
